description: Get The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s issuance runway on Robinhood Chain: cumulative STANDARD issued so far against the Central Bank's issuance budget, the current per-second stream rate, budget remaining, and a same-state projection of when the budget runs out if that rate holds (`projected_end_at_current_multiplier`). `issuance_end_raw` is the contract's own measured end timestamp and is the authoritative figure; the projection can diverge from it once the policy multiplier changes, see 1s_std_policy_outlook. Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings. Divide by 1e18 to get token amounts.
name: 1s_std_issuance_runway
title: TSR Issuance Runway
